senses.zh: 提供餐饮；满足需求；迎合
senses.definition: To provide food for an event, meet particular needs, or satisfy someone's wishes.
senses.example: The cafe caters for people who do not eat meat.

reviewNotes: 餐饮服务、满足需求与迎合均覆盖，for/to搭配正确。

author: vocab_author_c

senses.definition: A two-player board game whose goal is to attack the other king so that it has no legal way to escape.
senses.example: She learned to play chess with her grandfather.

reviewNotes: 细化目标为使对方王受攻且无合法脱困，而非笼统困住。

author: vocab_author_c

senses.definition: A large desert animal with one or two humps, or a light brown colour.
senses.example: The camel carried supplies across the desert.

reviewNotes: 一峰双峰动物与浅棕颜色名词清楚。

author: vocab_author_c

senses.definition: To follow rules or accepted behaviour, or match a required standard.
senses.example: All equipment must conform to the safety standards.

reviewNotes: 行为遵从与达到标准，to/with 搭配有效。

author: vocab_author_c

senses.zh: 值得花时间或精力的；有价值的
senses.definition: Useful or rewarding enough to justify the time, effort, or money needed.
senses.example: Helping at the library was a worthwhile experience.

reviewNotes: 价值足以值得投入而非单纯昂贵。

author: vocab_author_c

senses.zh: 芽；花蕾；老兄（非正式称呼）
senses.definition: A small growth that develops into a leaf or flower; also, an informal way to address a friend.
senses.example: The rose bushes are covered in buds.

senses.definition: To produce new leaf or flower growth, or begin developing.
senses.example: The trees began to bud after a week of warm weather.

reviewNotes: 植物芽、非正式朋友称呼与萌芽动词分开。

author: vocab_author_c

senses.definition: Goods sent together, or the act of sending goods from one place to another.
senses.example: The shop received a new shipment of books this morning.

reviewNotes: 货物一批和装运行为都覆盖。

author: vocab_author_c

senses.definition: Respect and approval for someone's qualities or achievements, or pleasure in something attractive.
senses.example: I have great admiration for her patience.

reviewNotes: 敬佩成就与欣赏美物匹配，耐心例句自然。

author: vocab_author_c

senses.definition: To remain strong or undamaged despite force, difficulty, or pressure.
senses.example: The roof is designed to withstand heavy snow.

reviewNotes: 经受压力后仍保持完整，不等于单纯经历。

author: vocab_author_c

senses.definition: Supplying water to land so crops can grow, or washing a body part with a flow of liquid.
senses.example: The farms depend on irrigation during the dry summer.

reviewNotes: 农作灌溉与医疗冲洗两义明示，未只用难懂术语。

author: vocab_author_c

senses.definition: To force someone to leave a place or organisation, or push something out.
senses.example: The school may expel students for serious violence.

reviewNotes: 迫使离开与排出气体都为及物用法。

author: vocab_author_c

senses.definition: The end of a species or something else that no longer exists, or the putting out of a fire.
senses.example: The species is at risk of extinction.

reviewNotes: 物种灭绝、事物消亡及火熄灭区别清楚。

author: vocab_author_c

senses.definition: Equipment used for a particular purpose, or the structure of an organisation or system.
senses.example: The laboratory has new apparatus for measuring air quality.

reviewNotes: 设备集合与制度组织结构两义保留。

author: vocab_author_c

senses.definition: Almost not, or only just.
senses.example: We had scarcely sat down when the phone rang.

reviewNotes: 几乎不、才刚；scarcely…when 时间结构正确。

author: vocab_author_c

senses.definition: A vegetable with many thick leaves packed closely into a round head.
senses.example: She chopped the cabbage for a salad.

reviewNotes: 卷心菜层层叶片的定义和切菜例句对应。

author: vocab_author_c

senses.definition: Not tight, not careful or strict enough, or lacking activity.
senses.example: The rope was too slack to hold the tent steady.

senses.zh: 松弛部分；富余能力；长裤（slacks）
senses.definition: The loose part of a rope, unused capacity, or, in the plural, casual trousers.
senses.example: Pull the rope until there is no slack left.

senses.definition: To work with less effort than you should, or become less active.
senses.example: Do not slack off just because the manager is away.

reviewNotes: 松散清淡形容词、绳松余量/长裤名词与偷懒动词清楚。

author: vocab_author_c

senses.definition: Wood prepared for building, especially in American English, or unwanted bulky objects in British English.
senses.example: The shed was built from recycled lumber.

senses.zh: 笨重地移动；使背负负担
senses.definition: To move slowly and heavily, or burden someone with an unwanted duty or object.
senses.example: The old truck lumbered up the hill.

reviewNotes: 美式木材、英式杂物与笨重移动/负担动词区分。

author: vocab_author_c

senses.definition: Common or widespread in a place or at a time.
senses.example: These beliefs were prevalent in the region a century ago.

reviewNotes: 某时地普遍出现，不误作为质量优势。

author: vocab_author_c

senses.definition: Kind or not harmful; in medicine, not cancerous when describing a growth.
senses.example: The specialist described the lump as benign.

reviewNotes: 日常温和及肿瘤非癌性两义区分，未说良性一定没有危害。

author: vocab_author_c

senses.definition: The day or evening before a holiday or important event.
senses.example: The family gathers on Christmas Eve.

reviewNotes: 重要日之前一天或夜晚，圣诞前夜搭配正确。

author: vocab_author_c

senses.definition: To take someone away by force and keep them against their will.
senses.example: The gang kidnapped a businessman and demanded money.

reviewNotes: 违背意愿强行带走，不限儿童，不要求一定索赎。

author: vocab_author_c

senses.zh: 恰当的；易于……的；有天赋的
senses.definition: Suitable for a situation, likely to do something, or quick to learn.
senses.example: Her description of the noisy room was very apt.

reviewNotes: 恰当、容易发生与善学三义兼顾。

author: vocab_author_c

senses.definition: Serious, sincere, and determined rather than joking or careless.
senses.example: He made an earnest effort to improve his writing.

senses.definition: Serious intention, especially in 'in earnest'; also, money given as proof of an intention to buy.
senses.example: Work on the new bridge began in earnest in March.

Checked separate deposit/pledge noun before retaining as a labeled secondary meaning.

reviewNotes: 真诚认真形容词、in earnest与定金名词分别标明。

author: vocab_author_c

senses.definition: The best or most suitable for a particular purpose or situation.
senses.example: Plants grow faster under optimal light and temperature conditions.

reviewNotes: 特定目的最佳不等于绝对完美。

author: vocab_author_c

senses.zh: 连贯的；条理清楚的；一致的
senses.definition: Clear and logically connected, or forming a whole whose parts fit together.
senses.example: She gave a coherent account of what had happened.

reviewNotes: 条理逻辑及整体相容两义清楚。

author: vocab_author_c

senses.definition: The quality of being easy to understand or use, or plain without unnecessary detail.
senses.example: I like this design for its simplicity.

reviewNotes: 简单易用及朴素风格均覆盖。

author: vocab_author_c

senses.zh: 订书钉；主食；主要产品或常用品
senses.definition: A small wire fastener for paper, or a basic food or item regularly used or produced.
senses.example: Rice is a staple in many Asian countries.

senses.definition: To join sheets of paper or other materials with a small wire fastener.
senses.example: Please staple the receipt to the form.

senses.definition: Basic and regularly used, especially when describing food or products.
senses.example: Potatoes are a staple ingredient in many local dishes.

reviewNotes: 订书钉、主食、主要品类名词，钉住动词，常备形容词均保留。

author: vocab_author_c

senses.zh: 保密的；机密的；表示信任的
senses.definition: Intended to remain private, or spoken in a way that suggests trust and secrecy.
senses.example: Please keep these financial records confidential.

notes: Removed misleading 易于信任他人: confidential is not the same as trusting or gullible.
reviewNotes: 保密及私下信任的语气，不是轻信别人的性格。

author: vocab_author_c

senses.definition: The story of someone's life written by that person.
senses.example: She published her autobiography after retiring from teaching.

reviewNotes: 本人写自己人生，与 biography 区别明确。

author: vocab_author_c

senses.zh: 兼容的；合得来的；可并存的
senses.definition: Able to work, live, or exist together without problems.
senses.example: Check that the new charger is compatible with your phone.

reviewNotes: 共同工作生活无冲突，compatible with 结构正确。
